answer: Old entry fees failed: a refundable deposit is a loan, and attackers get it back. The sybil tax fixes that. A new identity pays a 90-unit non-refundable genesis tax. A 4-epoch observation follows. Each honest epoch returns 15% as fee credit. Faking burns the remaining tax and freezes the identity 8 epochs. The shale layer cannot recycle the same capital. The sonnet check verifies each epoch's work first. A knoll of clones still pays per head. 1,000 clones pay 90,000 units. If 30% are caught, 27,000 units burn. The tax is sunk, so forgery pays full price per identity.
